name: Tyvar the Bellicose — attacking Elves gain deathtouch from the attack trigger
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. Needed both fixes: 'they' in a 'one or more Elves you control attack' trigger resolves to 'Attacking Elves you control', and 'Elves' is recognised as a plural creature type. The attacking Elf gains deathtouch; the Elf that stayed home and the attacking Bear do not.

call: they gain deathtouch until end of turn.
Whenever one or more Elves you control attack, they gain deathtouch until end of turn.
